It started with a calendar invite called Kick-off møte: Ronny oppstart. Twelve months later there is a wheel loader clearing a mountain pass with nobody in the cab, and a VLA up and running at Feiring. Thirteen frames from the year, pulled straight out of my camera roll.

Year two

Thanks for the first one

Twelve months ago the operator station in Kristiansand was a chair and two screens I did not understand. Over the last couple of weeks we have had the VLA up and running at Feiring.

One year from a kick-off meeting to that. I did none of the hard parts, so thanks to everyone who built it, rigged it, drove it and kept it running through every last-minute change.

I am properly psyched about what we do next.

Ronny

How this was put together3,426 photos taken between 1 September 2025 and 1 September 2026, matched by GPS and timestamp against the work calendar, then filtered down to the thirteen above. Coordinates are read from the image files. The 924 figure counts every non-cancelled entry in the calendar over those twelve months, private ones included.
